subtitle: Every credential the hub has issued: phones, watches, browsers and Persona Link on your computers. Revoke whichever one you lose; the rest keep working.
managed_by_named: Devices are managed by the primary hub "{name}"
managed_by_primary: Devices are managed by the primary hub
member_detail: This hub is a member of a group. The primary hub issues and revokes credentials for phones, watches and browsers; devices already paired here don't need to pair again. To pair a new phone or revoke a device, go to the primary hub's admin page.
footer: A revoked device disconnects right away and has to pair again to reconnect. The main token (token in hub.json) isn't listed here; change it in hub.json.
empty_detail: Scan the code with the Persona app to pair, and its credential shows up here.
scan_left: Scan with the Persona app. Pairs one device; expires in {left}.
scan_expired: Scan with the Persona app. Pairs one device; expired.
copy_pair_link: Copy pairing link (to paste on a Mac)
qr_warning: The QR code and link work like credentials. Don't share screenshots of them.
